M1.reason: Every view (front, left, back, right, top, below, four angles) shows one plain box, 64 wide, 40 high and 40 deep, with nothing sticking out or missing. The brief gives no slope or shape beyond waist high, so a box fits its words. The outline is plain, though, with no sloped control face.

M2.reason: Measured 40 x 64 x 40 against a height of 40 asked (sizeOff 0). The height is exact and the width and depth are within the 15% band.

M3.reason: The brief's parts are present but two are wrong in form. The dials are four orange squares painted on the front face (front view, left of the screens), not round dials, so the round part has the wrong number of sides. The two screens are green rectangles on the front, and the switches are six black painted rectangles in a row under them. Nothing protrudes in any side view, so the controls are paint only, which counts when it reads, but the dials read as square tiles at the size shown.

M4.reason: Grey painted steel body with a darker top, green screens, orange dials, black switches and a yellow-black hazard stripe at the base. These read as the industrial palette the brief asks for (green-grey, yellow hazard paint, rusted steel). No region is in a clearly wrong colour or material.

M5.reason: The brief's markings are there in their places: two screens and four dials on the front, a row of six switches, the hazard stripe along the bottom edge, and a grainy steel texture with worn edges on the sides and top. The sharpness is close to the game's own.
